headline: 2 ‘Strong Buy’ IPO Stocks JPMorgan Thinks Are Worth Watching
summary: The IPO market has made an impressive comeback this year. Momentum began building in the first quarter and accelerated in the second, with traditional IPOs raising $114.1 billion through June 30, 2026 – roughly seven times the amount raised during the first half of 2025. SpaceX, the largest IPO in Wall Street history, understandably dominated the headlines and made Elon Musk the world’s first trillionaire, but the strength of the market extended well beyond a single blockbuster listing.Claim 55%
